# crosswork_device_alarm_manager (Resource)

This resource can manage the device alarm manager of alarms and events.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_device_alarm_manager" "example" {
  models = { "Cisco ASR 9010 Router" = true, "Cisco ASR 9006 Router" = false }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `models` (Map of Boolean) Enabled state by device model, for example `Cisco 8201 Router`

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_device_alarm_manager.example "device_alarm_manager"
```
